facts.text: I'm only here for the food, and the band's not bad either. Don't read anything into it.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Kat never says this. The Kat lines on the Wikiquote page include nothing about food or the band, and the only food in that list is Patrick making Spaghettios.
facts.fix: Tray up. Eat fast, I've got a poem due and a boy to ignore.

fix_note.text: Tray up. Eat fast, I've got a poem due and a boy to ignore.

vibe.verdict: A tidy school canteen with the right plot beats, but the writing is generic and has none of Kat's bite.

ideas: Swap 'Prom night pasta' for 'Patrick's Spaghettios', a tin of spaghetti on toast with a guitar pick on the side.
Swap period 5 'Sport' for 'Stadium serenade' so the timetable runs through the whole singing scene.
Swap the plain 'Prom Ticket' line 'Bring a date, or don't' for 'Bring a date. Someone may have paid him.'
Move 'Paintball splatter meatballs' onto the printed menu in place of 'Bogey's party spinach dip', since the paintball date is the film's best food-free setpiece.
